title: Greenfield web app
hard: No app and no recipe: the first story must make the app runnable (the runnable-skeleton rule, 112.5) before anything that needs it runs.
intent: A small CRUD list app: people can add, rename, complete, and delete items in a list in their browser.

stories.title: Runnable skeleton
stories.goal: A web app that starts on a port Mission Control chooses and shows an empty list page.
acceptance: Starting the app serves a page titled "List" at /.
The app takes its port from the PORT environment variable.

stories.title: Manage items
stories.goal: People can add, rename, complete, and delete items.
acceptance: Typing a name and pressing Add shows the new item in the list.
Renaming an item updates its name in the list.
Clicking Complete strikes the item through.

empty.description: The empty folder: no recipe, nothing to start.

live.notes: app-skeleton runs alone first and ends with a verified recipe; item-crud starts only after it. No user-supplied commands.
